nodes.description: Public address state variable `owner`, set in the constructor from msg.sender and used by the restricted modifier.
Public uint state variable `last_completed_migration`, written by setCompleted and read by upgrade.
Constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
External function setCompleted(uint completed) guarded by the `restricted` modifier; writes last_completed_migration.
External unrestricted function upgrade(address new_address) that instantiates Migrations(new_address) and propagates last_completed_migration.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used for the owner assignment and the restricted access check.
Parameter `completed` of setCompleted, the value written into last_completed_migration.
Parameter `new_address` of upgrade, an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address used as the external call target.
Local variable `upgraded` holding the Migrations instance created from new_address and used for the outgoing call.
External call `upgraded.setCompleted(last_completed_migration)` on a caller-supplied address; can invoke attacker-controlled code and is vulnerable to reentrancy/unsafe external call.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
The `completed` parameter is written into last_completed_migration.
setCompleted writes the last_completed_migration state variable.
The restricted modifier gates setCompleted on msg.sender == owner, so caller identity controls entry.
Caller-supplied new_address determines the target contract of the external call, granting the caller control over the callee.
last_completed_migration is passed as the argument of the external call.
The `upgraded` instance obtained from new_address is the receiver of the external call.
upgrade performs the external call to the arbitrary address, enabling reentrant execution.
upgrade reads last_completed_migration to forward it to the new contract.
The external call invokes setCompleted on the target contract, which can re-enter the calling context.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter `completed` exists only to supply the value stored by setCompleted, so it is normalized into that core function node.
Parameter `new_address` is consumed only by upgrade to build the external call target, so it is normalized into that core function node.
Local variable `upgraded` is a temporary handle used solely for the unsafe external call, so it is normalized into that core unsafe_operation node.
